text:
Sophie: FYI — competitor 'VectorRoute' just launched a low-latency multi-model routing product (they call it 'FastRoute'). ACME and a couple of mid-market customers pinged us. Quick sync: do we ship a parity shim or push our differentiated routing later? Need scope recs for next sprint.

Raj: Infra quick note — parity shim (route-by-priority fallback) looks like ~2 dev-weeks + ~0.5 infra-week. Biggest risk is kv-cache invalidation in corner cases.

Leah: Sales signal: ACME explicitly said they'd consider switching if latency gating is solved. They want a clear timeline. Can we promise 2w?

Aisha: Design: console changes for a parity toggle are small — we can mock a toggle + banner in 1–2 days.

Ben: Product framing — two options: A) Quick parity v1 (ship shim + UI toggle) to stop churn B) Hold for our cost-aware smart-routing differentiator (6–8w). Tradeoffs: churn vs long-term economics.

Sophie: We need concrete launch criteria. For ACME they expect p95 <= 120ms on their workload and per-tenant routing controls parity.

Raj: We can reliably hit p95=120ms with the parity shim for most slices, but p99 is shaky. To stabilize p99 we need batching/kv-cache fixes (extra ~3w).

Leah: If we say 2w and miss, we lose credibility. Sales suggests shipping parity fast but mark it as 'experimental' with SLA caveats.

Aisha: UX note — if experimental, expose a warning banner + an opt-in telemetry toggle so early customers can help debug.

Ben: My proposal: ship a minimal parity MR in next sprint (2w) with clear must-haves and defer deep p99 work to v2. Must-haves: route-by-priority toggle, basic metrics in Console, docs + opt-in banner. Nice-to-haves for v2: p99 stability work, automatic failovers, cost-routing policies.

Sophie: Agree. Add launch guardrails: require internal perf tests (synthetic + ACME sample) pass p95<=120ms and no regression >5% on cost.

Raj: I can own infra changes. Plan: branch today, staging perf tests by Thu, canary Fri. Need QA support for the perf harness.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created staging job r/fastroute-parity (ci-3291). Status: queued.

Leah: Sales will tell ACME we have an experimental toggle and a canary next week. I'll try to get them on the pilot.

Ben: Action items:
- Raj -> branch + infra PR
- Aisha -> toggle mock + banner copy
- Sophie -> write launch criteria doc + notify support
- Leah -> coordinate ACME pilot
- QA -> add perf harness (Sophie loop in)

Next sync: Fri 10am. :calendar: 

Sophie: :thumbsup: creating the doc + checklist now.
